node.title: Capacidad humana utilizable
node.summary: People must be able to perceive and exercise an option within the operating architecture.

relations: A testable question is whether newly perceived options become usable only when the operating architecture also permits action.
No hay base para afirmar que mindfulness o coaching reducen HID. Intervenciones personales, cambios de proceso y contexto deben medirse por separado.
The recovery coefficient turns the atrophy claim into a bounded question: how much released capacity becomes genuine contribution again for the same capability and cohort?
ρ menor que uno y la irreversibilidad son hipótesis a estimar; no asumir un techo inferior a uno ni llamar recuperación a cambiar a la persona de tarea.
An intense intervention should end with recovery and transfer conditions that preserve the team's capability rather than treating sustained overload as proof of commitment.
No se diagnostica atrofia clínica ni se confirma irreversibilidad a partir de un relato de cansancio.
The talent-formation model suggests how coherence-carrying capacity could be cultivated and observed through work rather than inferred from credentials or headcount.
κ requiere definición e instrumento propios; la trayectoria formativa no proporciona automáticamente un score validado.
The 01K extension imports the HID research line while keeping runtime response capacity distinct from instrument-gated architectural debt measurement.
No se ha publicado aquí una cifra HID ni se convierten tokens o carga de supervisión en unidades canónicas del instrumento.
Human accountability requires effective intervention capacity as well as authority; a nominal approval does not repair an unsupported or time-expired decision.
Propuesta de revisión de gobierno; no se certifica la dotación ni la seguridad de ningún equipo real.
Tacit-knowledge transmission could inform a recovery study that distinguishes freed hours from renewed capability to handle novel exceptions.
No se asigna un valor ρ ni se presenta aprendizaje relatado por un Tiger Team como prueba de irreversibilidad.
The human cost of clarity includes keeping intervention capacity available, maintaining it and qualifying alternative information routes, not only time spent on a case.
La clasificación es propuesta para instrumentación; no constituye una cifra HID o un coste medido.
